text: ひろって　うれば　もうかるぜえ

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: Changing a verb's ending to ば means 'if' you do it. うれば = 'if you sell them'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and then'. ひろって = 'pick them up and'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, manly emphasis, drawled out here as ぜえ. もうかるぜえ = 'you'll make money, I tell ya'.
